authorizes: nothing; this config has no runtime, no venue access, and no REAL_MONEY implication. Binance execution capability does not exist in this repository; this registration accrues research evidence only.
claim: The financed-leaders rule executed Binance-native (Binance turnover ranks, Binance settled funding, BTC gate from Binance prices) earns bench-window Sharpe 1.66 raw on the full-calendar basis (t 3.04) with total return +993% versus the benchmark's +15.85%. CORRECTED 2026-07-26, same day as registration: it beats the deployed CONTINUOUS benchmark on RETURN but NOT on Sharpe (1.66 vs 1.84) once flat days are counted in the denominator as the benchmark counts its own; the 2.12 first quoted was an active-days-only figure and was not apples-to-apples. This is a REPLICATION registration, not an independent discovery and not a benchmark-beating claim: it is the venue arm that makes lane2_financed_leaders_v1 the first positive mechanism family in this program to survive cross-venue replication (effect ratio 0.65). Its daily net correlates +0.82 with the Bybit book; it is registered so the forward record grades both arms symmetrically.

cost_model.charging: measured one-way turnover x fee per side
cost_model.fee_note: 7.78 bp/side is the BYBIT demo measurement applied unchanged; Binance USD-M taker tiers are comparable (4.5-5.0 bp/side typical) so the charge is mildly conservative. No Binance fill has ever been measured by this repository.

scoring_recipe.metric: mean net bp per day, and annualised Sharpe on raw and vol-targeted daily series
secondary: effect ratio versus the Bybit arm
scoring_recipe.comparator: lane2_financed_leaders_v1 (the Bybit arm) and the deployed CONTINUOUS sl35 render
scoring_recipe.cadence: one row per completed UTC day after the registration commit
scoring_recipe.eligibility: only days strictly after the registration commit date count as forward evidence

benchmark_window_2023_03_13_to_2026_07_1.basis_note: PRIMARY basis is full-calendar (flat days = 0), matching the benchmark's own accounting. Corrected 2026-07-26 same day as registration.

active_days_only.note: per-deployed-capital view; NOT comparable to the benchmark Sharpe

benchmark_window_2023_03_13_to_2026_07_1.verdict: beats the benchmark on RETURN only; does NOT beat on full-calendar Sharpe (1.66 vs 1.84). Registered as the replication arm, not as a benchmark-beating book.

measured_at_registration.provenance: Lane-1 exploration on 2021-01-01..2026-07-18 selected the parent rule on Bybit; this arm applies it unchanged to Binance data. Full evidence note: docs/research_2026-07-26_financed_longs.md.

known_weaknesses: does NOT beat the benchmark on full-calendar Sharpe (1.66 vs 1.84); the initial 2.12 quote was active-days-only and was corrected the same day

corr +0.82 with the Bybit arm: this is the same mechanism on largely the same names (79.9% universe Jaccard, docs/anomaly_research_2026-07-24.md section 18.4); it multiplies venue evidence, not portfolio breadth
t 3.04 is below the program-wide ~3.4 Bonferroni threshold as a standalone discovery; its evidentiary role is as the replication arm of the Bybit registration
no Binance execution, fills, or fee measurement exists in this repository; every number here inherits the Bybit fee assumption
2022 is -10.5 bp/day (the Bybit arm is -3.9): the financing condition protects less on Binance
all weaknesses of the parent rule apply
